text: Most visits to Qatar's primary health centres are walk-ins.
asr: Most visits to Qatar's primary health centers are walk-ins.

text: Each one starts at the front desk, where staff record why you came.
Then come triage, the doctor and the pharmacy.
asr: Then come Triov, the doctor and the pharmacy.

text: Qatar's apps, Nar-aakom and Lbaih, handle appointments and records.
say: Qatar's apps, Nar aakom and Lbaih, handle appointments and records.
asr: Katar's apps, NAR Akum and Labe, handle appointments and records.

text: But in our research, we found no digital path for walk-ins.
That is the gap.
This is Dawri, دوري, which means 'my turn'.
say: This is Dowree, which means, my turn.
asr: This is Dowry, which means my turn.

text: Dawri is an AI front desk.
say: Dow-ree is an AI front desk.
asr: Dowry is an AI front desk.

text: Fatima, 34, checks in on her phone before she arrives. This is a demo, with synthetic patients.
say: Fatima, thirty four, checks in on her phone before she arrives. This is a demo, with synthetic patients.

text: She tells the AI receptionist, in Arabic, by text or voice: fever and cough for three days.
It asks a few short questions,
one at a time.
She picks a centre on a map with estimated waits.
asr: She picks a center on a map with estimated weights.

text: That is a reservation, not yet a place in line.
When she arrives, she taps 'I'm here'. Her ticket activates and gets a number, T-014. Order comes from arrival and the centre's own priority rule. Plain code, no AI.
say: When she arrives, she taps, I'm here. Her ticket activates and gets a number, T zero one four. Order comes from arrival and the centre's own priority rule. Plain code, no AI.
asr: When she arrives, she taps I'm here. Her ticket activates and gets a number T014. Order comes from arrival and the center's own priority rule. Plain code, no AI.

text: At triage, the nurse sees her exact words, the AI's intake, and her penicillin allergy.
The nurse enters vitals and confirms the handoff to the doctor.
The doctor prescribes, and the system warns about amoxicillin, because of her penicillin allergy.
Then the pharmacy, and the visit is done.
Ahmed asks for his usual blood-pressure pills. He is offered the refill route, with no ticket.
asr: Akmed asks for his usual blood pressure pills. He is offered the refill route with no ticket.

text: Ravi types that he has chest pain spreading to his arm.
A rule catches it first. He sees 'call 999' and the nearest hospital, and gets no ticket.
say: A rule catches it first. He sees call nine nine nine and the nearest hospital, and gets no ticket.
asr: A rule catches it first. He sees call 999 in the nearest hospital and gets no ticket.

text: Safety does not depend on the model behaving.
Rules check every message for emergency wording, in Arabic and English, and a hit stops the chat. The model cannot overrule it.
A model's reply reaches the patient only if it is one short, plain question. The AI never diagnoses and never prescribes.
A nurse confirms everything before the doctor sees it, and the queue is code the AI cannot touch.
asr: A nurse confirms everything before the doctor sees it, and the cue is code the AI cannot touch.

text: And we say plainly: no clinician has reviewed our red-flag list yet.
Under the hood: a FastAPI service with SQLite and a React app, in one Docker container on a Hugging Face Space.
asr: Under the hood, a fast API service with SQLite and a React app in one Docker container on a hugging face space.

text: Chat, intake and the nurse's handoff draft run on Gemma 4 26B, through Hugging Face Inference Providers. Whisper large-v3-turbo handles speech.
say: Chat, intake and the nurse's handoff draft run on Gemma four, twenty-six B, through Hugging Face Inference Providers. Whisper large, v3 turbo, handles speech.
asr: Chat, intake, and the nurse's handoff draft run on Gemma 4, 26B, through hugging face inference providers. Whisper large, V3 turbo, handle speech.

text: We wanted Qatar's Fanar, but its only provider had no capacity.

text: So we fine-tuned Fanar 9B ourselves. Valid intakes rose from 6 to 56 of 63, but it lost emergency recognition, so it stays out of live chat.

asr: So we fine-tuned Funarn 9B ourselves. Valid intakes rose from 6 to 56 of 63, but it lost emergency recognition, so it stays out of live chat.

text: Our aim: take the reception step off the walk-in's path, and give nurses a structured intake, with people deciding everything clinical.
